content_sections.heading: NIAB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 29 / 2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NIAB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine with 2 years experience Experience: 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organisations and Scientific activities and services. Age limit: Maximum 35 years Desirable: Candidate with experience in Natural product chemistry, Soxlation, Isolation and characterization of active molecules from a plant source, HPTLC, HPLC, etc will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIAB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications Notification via email Interview by a duly constituted selection committee through an online mode Suitable candidates will be screened, notified via email, and interviewed by a duly constituted selection committee through an online mode.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original documents supporting date of birth Educational qualifications Experience certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIAB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Applications are to be filled ONLINE. Complete the online application form available at www.niab.res.in. No need to send a hard copy. Apply on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only Provisional Degree Certificate or Convocation Degree Certificate will be accepted as proof of educational qualification. Experience certificates must be issued by the Head of the Department/Office.
